english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is hard or not easy.
This is the all-purpose choice for something that is difficult or hard to do.
Use 難 as the all-purpose choice for something that is difficult or demanding.
This is the all-purpose choice for something difficult to do, understand, or deal with.
Use this when “mean” describes a problem or task as difficult or tricky.

examples.english: This math problem is very difficult.

ni1 fan6 gung1 fo3 hou2 naan4

examples.english: This math problem is really tough.
examples.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sou3 hok6 tai4 zan1 hai6 naan4

examples.english: This is a mean maths problem.
examples.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sou3 hok6 tai4 gei2 naan4 gaa3
